Deadline Approaching for LAF Scholarships

More than $150,000 is available to students through 16 different scholarships. Applications are due February 1.
January 12, 2026
Partnerships Education Students
Twitter
Facebook
LinkedIn
Instagram

The Landscape Architecture Foundation (LAF) reminds students about its 2026 scholarship opportunities. More than $150,000 is available through 16 different scholarships established by generous sponsors. Applications are due February 1.

LAF scholarships are open to students enrolled at colleges and universities in the U.S. and Canada. Additional eligibility requirements vary by award. Full application materials – including any required letters of recommendation, essays, or work samples – must be submitted by the deadline.

Learn more at: www.LAFoundation.org/scholarships

For Master's Students:

•    LAF Honor Scholarship in Memory of Joe Lalli, FASLA - $20,000 winner, $10,000 first runner-up, $5,000 second runner-up

•    LAF Honor Scholarship for Inclusive Community Design - $10,000 winner, $5,000 runner-up

•    Kenneth R. Brooks MLA Research Scholarship - $5,000

•    MIG Scholarship for the Planning and Design of Equitable and Inclusive Environments - Two $5,000 winners

For Undergraduates:

•    ASLA Council of Fellows Scholarships - $10,000 winner, up to four $5,000 runners-up

•    Courtland Paul Scholarship - $5,000

•    LandDesign Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion Scholarships - Two $5,000 winners + mentoring

•    Landscape Forms Scholarship in Memory of Peter Lindsay Schaudt, FASLA - $5,000

•    Landscape Forms Shane Coen Scholarship for Diversity in Design - $5,000

•    Rain Bird Intelligent Use of Water™ Scholarship - $5,000

For Grad or Undergraduate Students:

•    Daniel Zwier/Permaloc Innovation Scholarship - $5,000

•    EDSA Diversity Scholarships - Two $5,000 winners

•    Steven G. King Play Environments Scholarship - $5,000

Location-Specific Scholarships:

•    Hawaii Chapter ASLA/David T. Woolsey Scholarship - $3,000

•    Peridian International, Inc./Rae L. Price, FASLA Scholarship - $5,000

Project Support:

•    Douglas Dockery Thomas Fellowship in Garden History and Design - $4,000

To date, the Landscape Architecture Foundation has awarded $2 million in sponsored scholarships to more than 650 students. These scholarships support new generations of landscape architects by rewarding superior student performance, supporting access and diversity, and assisting students with unmet financial need. Thank you to the scholarship sponsors for their commitment to the future of the discipline!
